description: Deletes a discrete or analog alarm of a WinCC Unified HMI; an unknown alarm is 404 not_found, nothing changed. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve: it runs every guard the real write runs and answers {dryRun:true, status:"plan_ok", hmi, ...} with no `postcheck`, changing nothing. A real write answers the re-read values and a `postcheck` {verified:true, requested, actual}; a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches, details.rollback: restored, not_restored or not_attempted): re-read before anything else. Needs an open project and a WinCC Unified HMI (hmi = its name from tia_hmis, matched ignoring case): a classic WinCC HMI is refused with 409 hmi_not_unified, an unknown HMI is 404 not_found and two HMIs with the same name are 409 ambiguous_name. Maps to DELETE /hmi/{hmi}/alarms/{kind}/{alarm}. M-off.

alarm.description: alarm name, as listed by tia_hmi_alarms

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

hmi.description: HMI name, as listed by tia_hmis (a WinCC Unified HMI)

kind.description: discrete (raised by a bit of a tag) or analog (raised by comparing a numeric tag with a value)

name: tia_hmi_alarm_delete
title: TIA — delete HMI Unified alarm
